title: Glass Quest
description: Glass Quest – Fill the Cup, Beat the Level! Drop colorful balls into the glass and fill it up to complete each level! Be careful—every mistake costs a life. Watch your aim and timing to keep the balls in the glass. Fun, simple, and addictive puzzle gameplay awaits. Precision-based fun Five lives per level Quick and casual gameplay Can you fill the glass without spilling a single drop?
instructions: Desktop Click to drop balls into the glass Fill the glass without missing or spilling balls Mobile Tap the screen to release balls Fill the glass without missing or spilling balls
